description: Procurement of 1,400,000 Bbls +/-5% of Gas Oil (0.05% M.S.) (05 shipments) during the period from 2025-11-15 to 2026-06-14
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2025-10-27 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - The Ceylon Petroleum Corporation has invited bids from its registered suppliers to award a term contract for the procurement of 1,400,000 Bbls +/-5% of Gas Oil (0.05% M.S.) (05 shipments), during the period from 2025-11-15 to 2026-06-14. 07 bidders have submitted bids for the same. The proposal made by the Minister of Energy to award the said procurement to M/s. Trafigura Pte. Ltd. of Singapore, based on the recommendation of the Standing High Level Procurement Committee, was approved by the Cabinet.
